Ecosystem Control room Workspace Domain Knowledge Frequently Asked Questions Request demo How long does it take to implement? Most firms are live in weeks, not months. Implementation typically starts with connecting key systems and activating Ravical in the inbox, then expands from there. There is no long integration project or system replacement required. Is our data safe and confidential? Yes. Your data remains your data. Ravical is built for regulated accounting and tax environments, with secure, permissioned access and clear auditability. Client information is never used to train public models. How do we stay in control of outputs and client communication? Ravical prepares opportunities and drafts communication, but advisors remain in control. All outputs follow firm defined rules for tone, standards, and escalation, and nothing is sent to clients without the level of human review you choose. How much does it cost? Ravical is priced based on the value it creates for the firm. Pricing is aligned to outcomes such as advisory opportunities identified, services delivered, and overall commercial impact. Which software does Ravical connect with? Ravical connects to the systems accounting and tax firms already use, including email, practice management, CRM, document management, and core accounting and tax platforms. It sits above your existing stack and works across systems rather than replacing them. English Log in Request demo workspace Every insight starts with context. The unified knowledge layer that connects every source of firm data into a single AI-ready context. From CRM to email history, billing records to document systems: give AI the full picture it needs to deliver accurate, personalised insights. Request demo Request demo Capacity, inside the firm The capacity a firm needs to grow is already in the building. Ravical lets your people and AI carry the client work together, so growth stops depending on the next hire. MEMORY The firm knows every client Everything the firm knows about a client comes together in one place: what the systems hold, what was said on calls and in emails, what colleagues have learned over the years and what Ravical picks up as it works. Every signal, workflow and price that follows is built on it. Real-time opportunity recognition Catch advisory moments as they happen: when a client mentions expansion plans, regulatory deadlines, or operational challenges buried in routine correspondence. Automatic lead qualification AI assesses which opportunities match your firm's expertise and capacity, surfacing only the leads worth pursuing with clear revenue potential. Signal extraction at scale Analyse every client email across your entire firm simultaneously, ensuring no opportunity disappears in daily volume or gets overlooked by busy professionals. From every system and every conversation Client data from the CRM, the accounting file and the document system sits next to what came up in the last call and the last email thread. Every session and output for a client is linked to that client automatically. What your people know, kept A preference, a concern, a decision taken, a constraint to respect. Advisers add what they learn in a line, and it is there for every colleague who works on that client afterwards. What AI learns, kept too As Ravical works through a client’s file it records what it observes, with the source. The next workflow starts from a fuller picture than the last one, whoever runs it. SIGNAL Opportunity detection Revenue opportunities and risks sit inside the emails, documents, numbers and conversations the firm already handles. Ravical reads across all of them, for every client, and brings forward what deserves attention. Expertise-based matching Route detected opportunities to the team members with the right technical knowledge and service experience to convert the lead effectively. Relationship preservation Maintain continuity by considering existing client relationships and engagement history when assigning follow-up actions. Workload intelligence Distribute opportunities across your team strategically, preventing overload on key individuals while ensuring timely client engagement. More channels than any team can watch Client emails, regulatory changes, shifts in the numbers, meeting conversations, documents and lifecycle events. No team can follow all six for every client, so Ravical does. Extra services, across the whole book A holding structure review, an R&D tax credit check, a succession plan. Ravical finds the clients who need a service they do not buy yet, estimates what it is worth and lets the adviser qualify it or run it as a campaign across a segment. Risks, flagged in time A register that was never updated, a VAT return due with invoices missing, a filing three weeks out. Ravical raises each one with its urgency, so the firm deals with it before the client or the regulator does. WORKFLOWS How the work runs Workflows are how the firm’s way of working becomes repeatable. Each one pulls the client context, runs the steps, brings in the right expertise and stops where the adviser decides. The same work runs the same way for every client. Out of the box Ravical includes a library of workflows for the work every firm runs every week, from reviewing a year-end accounts file to a CGT return, MLR client acceptance or a monthly board report. They are available from the first login and filtered by service line. Built by you The workflow builder lets the firm encode how its own best work gets done, with its templates, sources and review steps. One good session can be turned into a workflow and run across the entire client book. Nothing goes out without partner approval Each workflow ends with the review step the firm sets, from a draft for the file owner to four eyes on sensitive work. The decision stays with the people who carry the responsibility. PRICE Value-based, by default Work that runs through Ravical comes with a proposed price based on its outcome, drawn from the firm’s own history, its rate card and the nature of the advice. The adviser reviews it before it reaches the client. Pricing on value is what lets the practice grow as the hours come down. A single place to review and approve Every proposed price arrives in the billing review with its reasoning.
